name: Wildlife Clinic Support Volunteer, Schuylkill Center
what_you_do: Support the wildlife clinic that treats injured and orphaned wild animals. Clinic Support is open at 16 and up; Animal Care requires 18.
who_can_apply: Clinic Support volunteers must be 16 or older (Animal Care requires 18+). Must attend a training session, sign the volunteer agreement and finish online ethics and safety courses.
duration: Minimum one 4-hour shift a week (about 20 hours a month)
deadline_text: 2026 in-person info sessions were February 7 and February 28; virtual sessions as needed. Fill out the application to hear about future sessions.
how_to_apply: Complete the Wildlife Clinic volunteer Google Form linked on the page.
notes: The general volunteer page says regular volunteers who work with children need Pennsylvania child abuse and criminal history clearances (free for volunteers).
